run_sample_goal: run the move_cube CLI to sample a goal trajectory at a given difficulty level
run_goal_from_config: run the move_cube CLI to load a goal trajectory from a config JSON file
run_evaluate_policy: run the move_cube CLI to evaluate a policy on a set of random goals
run_replay_all: run the move_cube CLI to replay all evaluation logs in a given directory
run_evaluate_and_check: run the move_cube CLI to evaluate a policy then replay and validate all logs
